messages:
maria g.: Starting triage for SignalX pilot — customer reporting 503s and repeated 429s on the embeddings route (/v1/embeddings). They’re on a small reserved pool. Need SE + runtime + infra to swarm. @alex can you jump in?

alex: on it. can you paste the last 30m logs or link to the dashboard? my first guess is retry storm + auth retries.

maria g.: pasted logs and dashboard -> https://rbw.infra/dash/signalx/embeddings (private link). snippet from proxy logs: 
```
2025-11-03T09:12:03Z ERROR proxy request failed 503 id=ae3f client=10.2.5.8 path=/v1/embeddings retries=3
2025-11-03T09:12:04Z WARN  rate_limiter reject 429 id=ae3f client=10.2.5.8
```

priya: looking at routing layer — traffic did spike to the dedicated pool and we see a flurry of retries. batching and KV cache hit rates dropped during the window (cache warmed back up after ~6m). possible prefix miss + retry amplification.

kevin: saw unusual token counts in billing logs for that customer — they appear to resend full prompt on each retry instead of using smaller retry body. if true, that multiplies token usage and load. Jordan (sales) can we get sample payloads?

jordan-sales: pinged SignalX legal/engineers. they DM'ed sample payloads (shared privately). they confirm client retries every ~2s for 503s. no exponential backoff configured.

sam: paging runtime oncall for assistance and potential short-term mitigations. @oncall-bot escalate to eng-runtime if no ack within 10m.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 created for eng-runtime. notify: sam, alex, priya.

devops-bot: Deploybot: starting hotfix deploy release/2025-11-03-rapid-fix to staging. CI passed.

alex: suggested short-term mitigation: apply route-level burst buffer and relax strict rate-limit for this pilot while we patch client. quick config suggestion: 
```
routes:
  - path: /v1/embeddings
    burst_limit: 1000
    rate_limit: 250
```
I'll apply to staging first.

maria g.: applied to staging. can we promote to the pilot prod pool? also customer asked about data residency implications if we move them to a different worker pool.

priya: confirmed: changing pool -> still in eu-west-1. no data leaves region. ok for short-term pool switch.

kevin: recommend canary rollout: 10% -> monitor token/latency/error -> ramp if healthy. also suggest offering a small credit for the pilot given the outage window. Jordan, want to handle customer communication/credit?

jordan-sales: yes please. estimate of failed requests we have so far ~4k failed embeddings over 2 hours. would propose a pilot credit equal to 1 day of usage or a negotiated % — I'll draft language.

sam: runtime will monitor error rate and set alert threshold to <1% for the route. posting live metrics in ~10m.

maria g.: summary/action items: Alex apply canary to prod -> Sam monitor INC12345 -> Priya confirm pool/region -> Jordan handle credit negotiation & customer comms. I'll open a follow-up ticket for postmortem and handoff to SE for remediation checklist.

alex: canary promoted at 2147777805. initial telemetry: error rate down from 6.2% -> 0.7%, latency stable.

jordan-sales: customer confirms errors dropped to near-zero after the canary. they’ll disable aggressive client retries and add exponential backoff. they asked for the credit proposal — I'll share once internal approved.

maria g.: thanks everyone — closing active triage here. I’ll file the postmortem and share with the customer by EOD. :thumbsup:
